g.aria-label: Choose what should happen, set the thresholds, pick the deployments — the sentence on the right reads it back to you.
Six kinds of rule. Each is a short form — nothing to write by hand.
At a clock time on chosen days, switch the fleet to a saved layout — for example a lean Night layout at 22:00 and the
full Day layout at 08:00. Weights can be prefetched ahead of time.
Free the GPU when nobody is
Switch GPU layouts at set times
A clock time in a timezone
